==English==
{{wikidata lexeme|L4499}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:af|approve<id:regard>|-al<id:nominal>|text=+|tree=1}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/əˈpɹuːvəl/|a=UK}}
* {{IPA|en|/əˈpɹuvəl/|a=US}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Naomi Persephone Amethyst (NaomiAmethyst)-approval.wav|a=GA}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-approval.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|uːvəl|s=3}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# An expression granting [[permission]]; an indication of [[agreement]] with a [[proposal]]; an [[acknowledgement]] that a person, thing{{,}} or event [[meet]]s [[requirement]]s.
#: {{ux|en|I need to get an '''approval''' on this purchase order.}}
# An expression of favorable [[acceptance]] and [[encouragement]]; a [[compliment]] that also [[condone]]s.
#: {{ux|en|Words of '''approval''' never seem to come from him.}}
# {{lb|en|especially|philately}} Something [[mail]]ed by a [[seller]] to a [[collector]] to match their [[state]]d [[interest]]s; the collector can [[approve]] of or [[return]] the item.

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|expression granting permission or indicating agreement}} {{l|en|approbation}}, {{l|en|sanction}}; See also [[Thesaurus:approval]]
* {{sense|expression of favorable acceptance and encouragement}} {{l|en|commendation}}; See also [[Thesaurus:praise]]

====Coordinate terms====
* {{l|en|authorization}} {{q|in some legal contexts, authorization is different from approval}}

====Derived terms====
{{col|en|disapproval|nonapproval|postapproval|preapproval|reapproval|unapproval|approval voting|fore-approval|pre-approval letter|sale on approval|seal of approval|stamp of approval
|type approval
}}

====Related terms====
* {{l|en|approve#Verb|pos=v}}, {{l|en|approved#Adjective|pos=adj}}
